content.text: add his project to the notice
I’ll check the project’s notice files to see where it belongs.
Which notice should I add this project to? I couldn’t find a `NOTICE` file in mr-boxington.
anywhere, make a file/directory as you see fit
I’ll add a root-level `NOTICE` file with the project name and license attribution.

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat LICENSE README.md AGENTS.md","max_output_tokens":4200}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short","max_output_tokens":1000}));

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/jdx/src/mr-boxington/NOTICE
+mr-boxington (mbx)
+https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington
+
+Copyright (c) 2026 Jeff Dickey
+
+Licensed under the MIT License. See LICENSE for the full license text.
*** End Patch"));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --no-index -- /dev/null NOTICE","max_output_tokens":1000}));

content.text: Added [NOTICE](/Users/jdx/src/mr-boxington/NOTICE) with mr-boxington’s project link, copyright, and MIT license reference.
